## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Per-fetch telemetry — each fetch inside a target run records
   `{host, url (S-6-gated), status, bytes, fetched_at, duration_ms,
   outcome}`; unevidenced fields absent, never zero-shaped; refusal /
   challenge / rights-reservation / robots / transport outcomes
   carried honestly.
2. The upstream-count pair (SIG-CONF-009) — the upstream's own count
   at fetch where exposed (`not_exposed` recorded, never a guess) vs
   the subjects held after the run, per target plus a run-level pair;
   `difference_pct` + closed classification; explained differences
   carry the closed reason vocabulary (`filtered`, `withheld_rows`,
   `pagination_cap`, `upstream_misreport`, `other:<class>`); an
   unexplained difference is recorded `unexplained` with its
   percentage — the >1 % fail rule binds where the check machinery
   reads it.
3. The SIG-INGEST-004 binding-version test — the logical claim
   identity includes `extractor_version` + `normalizer_version`; the
   withheld amendment is not applied; the versions bind into identity
   (`sig.claim-payload/2`) — new minting only, no stored row
   re-minted.
4. Schema — one new sqitch change (`deploy`/`revert`/`verify` + plan
   entry in dependency order); the report writer stays
   migration-compatible (a spine without the column writes the row
   without the field, never fails).
5. GQ-19 — real evaluator replacing the seam deferral; report mode
   kept; `not_evaluable` on missing surface/zero pairs, never a
   vacuous pass.
6. Stamps — `SIG-CONF-009` + `SIG-INGEST-004` in `pr/P35.34.md`.

## Self-review / gap analysis (closing)

- **One privacy boundary** — the S-6 scrub runs at write, inside
  `ops.run_report`: `host` always (credential-stripped, IP hosts
  suppressed), the full URL only on `raw-ok`/`derived-only` lanes
  with the gate passed, else `path_sha256`. The same scrub covers
  `per_fetch` rows AND the reconciliation pair targets — a mid-run
  review caught the pair `target` carrying a raw URL and it was
  repaired before commit, not smoothed. The transparency export's
  `_PER_FETCH_FIELDS` allow-list stays the PKG-12 shape
  (url/kind/fetched_at/path_sha256 never publish); the reconciliation
  column is deliberately absent from `v_transparency_run`.
- **Honesty tokens, never zero-shape** — `not_exposed` /
  `not_recorded` / `not_evaluable` / NULL are the recorded answers
  for unexposed counts, unevidenced fields, missing surfaces and
  pre-telemetry rows. `eval_gq19` returns `not_evaluable` on a spine
  without the column or with zero evaluated pairs — no check passes
  vacuously.
- **The MUST stands** — SIG-INGEST-004's versions bind into identity
  (`sig.claim-payload/2`): new minting only, additive, no stored row
  recomputed. A caller seal overrides a record-carried stamp, so a
  forged `extractor_version` on a record cannot out-vote the binding
  that actually ran. Correction paths (`bound_versions`) seal the
  superseded claim's own binding — a re-ingest under the same
  extractor dedups onto the corrected row.
- **Enforcement stays where the requirement puts it** — the >1 %
  unexplained fail binds "once the check is enforced"; `eval_gq19`
  measures and reports (registry `mode: report` kept; promotion is
  CONF-01's). The seam deferral is discharged into a real evaluator —
  no `D-` row filed because nothing residual is owed by this row.
- **Known limits recorded** — the interim lane basis is `D-P35.31-1`'s
  (row 313 owns the lane/class fields): unresolved sources publish
  host + `path_sha256` only. `document_outcomes` upstream-count
  fields are a precedence list — a connector that exposes its count
  under a new field name records `not_exposed` until the vocabulary
  is extended, never a guessed field.
